question: Put these events of Paul's Macedonian ministry (his second missionary journey) in the order they occurred.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Macedonia, Macedonian', p. 289

items: Paul receives a vision at Troas of a Macedonian man asking for help
Paul arrives at Neapolis, the port of Philippi, and declares the good news at Philippi
Paul journeys through Amphipolis and Apollonia to Thessalonica and Beroea
Threatened mob violence at Beroea forces Paul to depart from Macedonia

question: Put these early stages of Joseph's life in Egypt in the order they occurred.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Joseph', p. 107

items: Joseph, at age 17, brings a bad report about his half brothers to Jacob
Joseph's brothers sell him to Ishmaelite merchants for 20 pieces of silver
Joseph is sold to Potiphar, chief of Pharaoh's bodyguard
Joseph is afflicted with fetters as a prisoner in Egypt

question: Put these stages of the Philistines' history, as described in Insight, in the order they occurred.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Philistia, Philistines', p. 631-632

items: The Philistines migrate from the island of Crete to the coast of Canaan
Philistines reside at Gerar in southern Canaan in the time of Abraham and Isaac
The Philistines occupy the coastal cities of Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron, and Gath
Samson takes the lead in saving Israel out of the hand of the Philistines

question: Put these events at Marah in the order they occurred.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Marah', p. 318

items: The Israelites are delivered from the Egyptians at the Red Sea
The Israelites arrive at Marah and find the water undrinkably bitter
The Israelites give way to faithless murmuring against Moses
Moses casts a tree into the water at Jehovah's direction, and it becomes sweet

question: Put these turning points of Joseph's rise in Egypt in the order they occurred.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Joseph', p. 107; 'Manasseh', p. 305

items: Joseph is sold to Potiphar and later falsely imprisoned
Joseph is eventually made Egypt's food administrator
Pharaoh gives Joseph Asenath, daughter of the priest of On, as a wife
Joseph names his firstborn son Manasseh

question: Put these genealogical links between Enoch and Noah in generational order.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Methuselah', p. 390

items: Enoch, the faithful prophet
Methuselah, Enoch's son
Lamech, Methuselah's son
Noah, Lamech's son

question: Put these developments in ancient Phoenicia's leading city in order.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Phoenicia', p. 635

items: Sidon becomes the principal city of ancient Phoenicia
A colony from Sidon founds the city of Tyre
Tyre grows and eventually eclipses Sidon in importance
Phoenicia as a whole comes to roughly correspond to modern Lebanon

question: Put these events of Paul's later dealings with Macedonia and Achaia in order.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Macedonia, Macedonian', p. 289

items: Paul proceeds to Macedonia and is joined by Titus with word from Corinth
Paul writes his second letter to the Corinthians
A plot against Paul in Greece causes him to change his travel plans
Paul returns to Macedonia instead of sailing directly to Syria

question: Put these stages of Joseph's brothers' plot against him in order.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Joseph', p. 107

items: Joseph's brothers see him coming and scheme to kill him
Reuben persuades them to throw Joseph into a dry waterpit instead
Judah persuades the others to sell Joseph to a passing caravan instead of killing him
The brothers deceive Jacob into believing Joseph was killed by a wild beast

question: Put these facts about the region of Philistia in geographic order, from north to south along the coast.
reference: Insight on the Scriptures, Vol. 2, 'Philistia, Philistines', p. 631

items: Joppa, near Philistia's northern border
Ashdod, one of the five axis-lord cities
Ashkelon, another of the five axis-lord cities
Gaza, near Philistia's southern border
